rules: D15§4 exact root marker, lock state first, unknown host transaction configuration error; nested inside unknown txn нельзя признать fresh. Supported root callback reads write-handle, both caches bypass, no publication tentative; no-op/rollback/failure no version/memory advance. Finally clear marker per attempt. Incarnation changed smaller version не resurrect cache; fingerprint/generation changed likewise. Touch root mutation invalidates relevant request contributions even code-derived Request source; publication only root success.
guidance: P10b own change visible then rollback hides; nested unknown foreign snapshot rejection; supported joint host write allows/denies, no-op touch/version behavior. P16 200 seeds mutation success/no-op/retry/rollback. R57 local build/code token/incarnation/capture validation, old object cannot resurrect. DB restore test changes incarnation through proper fixture protocol, not writes denied panel_state through arbitrary mutate callback.
